name.zh: CTExcel 英国（中国电信英国卡）

tagline.en: China Telecom Europe's UK brand on EE — 180-day keep-alive with one SMS, China data bundles
tagline.zh: 中国电信（欧洲）英国品牌（EE网络）——一条短信保号180天，含回国流量包

description.en: CTExcel UK is China Telecom (Europe)'s MVNO on EE, built for students, travellers and UK–China commuters. Keep the number with any charged usage within 180 days (sending 'BAL' to 888 counts). The annual 365-day bundles have been delisted (2026-09): the 回国套餐 tab now sells two 180-day promo packs — 30GB for £22 (was £36) and 50GB for £28 (was £40); unlimited calls to 15 international directions; Wi-Fi Calling enabled. First activation must happen in the UK/EU with usage within 10 days.
description.zh: CTExcel UK 是中国电信（欧洲）旗下英国虚商品牌，走EE网络，面向留学生、旅客与中英往返人群。180天内任意一次计费使用（如发短信BAL到888查余额）即可保号；365天年包已下架（2026-09）：回国套餐页现售两款180天促销包——30GB 22英镑（原36）与50GB 28英镑（原40）；支持Wi-Fi Calling下无限拨打15个国际方向（含中国大陆）。需在英国/欧盟激活，且激活后10天内需有使用记录。

details.en:
CTExcel UK is the value pick among the two Chinese-operator UK brands: bundles are cheaper per GB than CMLink's, and the keep-alive bar is refreshingly low — any charged activity within 180 days (a call, an SMS, data use, a top-up or a bundle order) resets the clock; texting BAL to 888 for a balance check already counts.

Official FAQ states numbers terminated after 180 days of total inactivity cannot be reactivated, with an SMS warning sent around day 60. Signature plans (2026-09 storefront): the 365-day annual bundles (£15/15GB, £36/50GB) are gone — the 回国套餐 tab now lists 180-day packs at 30GB/£22 (promo from £36) and 50GB/£28 (promo from £40); when bundle data runs out you can still receive SMS without renewing. One card can carry a UK number plus a Chinese secondary number; with Wi-Fi Calling on, calls to Chinese numbers from within China are unlimited, TikTok/Telegram register fine, and the roaming IP is a genuine clean UK IP.

Roaming works across 34 countries (4G only). Like CMLink, first activation must be in the UK or EU (CTExcel: UK/EU only, not Hong Kong), and you need usage within 10 days of activation. Best for: heavy China-traffic users who want more data per pound and unlimited calls home; pick CMLink instead if 5G and mainland verification codes matter more.
details.zh:
在两家中国运营商英国卡中，CTExcel UK 是性价比之选：单位流量价格比CMLink更低，保号门槛也极低——180天内任意一次计费行为（打电话、发短信、用流量、充值或订购套餐）即算使用，给888发短信BAL查余额都算。官方FAQ明确：连续180天无任何使用将终止服务且号码无法重新激活，约60天时会收到短信提醒。主打套餐（2026-09官网）：365天年包（15英镑/15GB、36英镑/50GB）已下架——回国套餐页现售180天包：30GB/22英镑（原价36促销）与50GB/28英镑（原价40促销）；套餐流量用完后不续费仍可继续收短信。

支持一卡双号（英国号码+中国副号码）；开启Wi-Fi Calling后在中国境内可给中国号码无限通话，注册TikTok、Telegram等境外应用正常，上网IP为真正纯净的英国IP。可在34个国家漫游（目前仅4G）。与CMLink一样需在英国或欧盟首次激活（CTExcel仅限英国/欧盟，不含香港），且激活后10天内需有使用记录。适合流量需求大、想要更多每英镑数据和无限拨打国内电话的用户；

若更看重5G与内地验证码接收，选CMLink。

bestFor.en: Heavy UK–China data users: cheap 180-day China bundles (annual plans delisted), unlimited Wi-Fi Calling to China, and a £0 keep-alive trick (balance-check SMS).
bestFor.zh: 中英往返大流量用户：180天回国包便宜（年包已下架）、Wi-Fi Calling无限拨打国内、查余额短信即可零成本保号。

data.zh: 30GB中国大陆流量（另含1GB英国本地）

plansNote.en: Bundle prices per CTExcel UK official site 回国套餐 tab, rendered 2026-09-16: annual 365-day bundles delisted; current 180-day promos 30GB/£22 and 50GB/£28. Keep-alive rule (any charged usage per 180 days incl. 'BAL' to 888): official FAQ now sits behind login — corroborated by two independent 2026 third-party sources, re-verify when FAQ is reachable. SMS receiving continues after data exhaustion.
plansNote.zh: 套餐价格按CTExcel英国官网回国套餐页（2026-09-16渲染核验）：365天年包已下架，现行180天促销包30GB/22英镑、50GB/28英镑。保号规则（180天内任意计费使用，含发BAL到888）：官方FAQ现需登录才能访问——两个独立2026年第三方来源仍如此描述，待FAQ可访问时复核。流量用尽后仍可接收短信。
